content.title: Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors injury report: Who's playing, injured and questionable players, head-to-head records, team stats, and more (March 13, 2026)
content.text: Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors (Image via Getty)The Minnesota Timberwolves play the Golden State Warriors on March 13, 2026, at Chase Center. Minnesota enters the game with a 40-26 record and sits third in the Western Conference. Golden State is 32-33 and ninth in the standings.This game matters for both teams. Minnesota is trying to hold its playoff position, while Golden State is still fighting to remain in the play-in race. Injuries could affect how both teams approach the game, especially with uncertainty around several players.Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors Injury report before the game (March 13, 2026)The official injury report released on March 13 listed several players who are out or questionable.Minnesota has a few players assigned to the G League, while Anthony Edwards and Ayo Dosunmu are listed as questionable. Stephen Curry is out with knee pain, and Jimmy Butler III remains out after ACL surgery.Golden State Warriors injury report: • Jimmy Butler III: Out (Right ACL Surgery) • Stephen Curry: Out (Right Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome) • De’Anthony Melton: Questionable (Left Adductor Injury Management) • Moses Moody: Out (Right Wrist Sprain) • Quinten Post: Questionable (Bilateral Foot Injury Management)Draymond Green, Jonathan Kuminga, Brandin Podziemski, Buddy Hield, Trayce Jackson-Davis, and Gui Santos are available.Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors Recent resultsGolden State leads the all-time regular season series 78-59 across 137 games. Minnesota has had better results in recent meetings.The Timberwolves won 127-120 at Chase Center on December 12, 2025. They also won the most recent game between the teams, beating Golden State 108-83 on January 26, 2026.In the last ten games between the teams, Minnesota has six wins and Golden State has four. Minnesota has averaged 110.3 points per game in those matchups, while Golden State has averaged 106.2.Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors Team performance comparisonMinnesota has built its season around defense and balanced scoring. Anthony Edwards has had scoring games in the 28 to 35 point range. Julius Randle handles a large share of the offense. Rudy Gobert leads the team in rebounding with 11.4 per game and averages 1.59 blocks.Golden State is trying to stay in the play-in race but has struggled with injuries. Draymond Green leads the team with 5.3 assists per game. Jonathan Kuminga has taken on more responsibility during the team’s recent three-game losing streak. Edwards is Minnesota’s main scoring option.In the frontcourt, Rudy Gobert and Draymond Green bring different roles. Gobert focuses on rebounding and rim protection. Green contributes with defense and passing.Golden State may rely more on Jonathan Kuminga for scoring with Curry unavailable. Minnesota could also benefit from its bench depth, including Naz Reid’s rebounding.Minnesota Timberwolves vs Golden State Warriors Game outlook (March 13, 2026)Minnesota enters the game with the better record and a more stable lineup if Edwards plays. Golden State has a 19-14 home record at Chase Center and will try to use that advantage.With Curry unavailable and several injuries on the roster, Golden State may have difficulty matching Minnesota’s lineup in this game.
